clusters.pick_reason: #2600's diff has broader scope: in addition to settling parked JSON-mode responses on close(), it also clears `_requestToStreamMapping` (previously left dangling, which let a request id stay resolvable after close and let a send() suspended mid-`storeEvent()` await resurrect a retired correlation), and it adds a post-await re-check in send() to close that race. #2692 only addresses the response-settling half (via a differently-shaped -32000 'Connection closed' JSON-RPC error keyed per request id) and explicitly leaves the correlation-map leak unaddressed, so #2600 is the more complete fix to consolidate onto — any request-id-grouping/reuse-of-real-response nuance from #2692 worth keeping can be folded into #2600 during review.

clusters.pick_reason: #2600's diff has broader scope: in addition to settling parked JSON-mode responses on close(), it also clears `_requestToStreamMapping` (previously left dangling, which let a request id stay resolvable after close and let a send() suspended mid-`storeEvent()` await resurrect a retired correlation), and it adds a post-await re-check in send() to close that race. #2692 only addresses the response-settling half (via a differently-shaped -32000 'Connection closed' JSON-RPC error keyed per request id) and explicitly leaves the correlation-map leak unaddressed, so #2600 is the more complete fix to consolidate onto — any request-id-grouping/reuse-of-real-response nuance from #2692 worth keeping can be folded into #2600 during review.

members.title: fix(server): retire in-flight request state when the streamable HTTP transport closes
members.author: rxits
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both fix WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport.close() failing to settle pending JSON-response-mode POST requests: handleRequest()'s Promise<Response> for JSON mode is only resolved by send(), and close() tore down the stream mapping/state without resolving it, leaving the HTTP request hanging until the platform's own socket/timeout eventually killed it. (2 PRs)
